message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to order a birthday cake online, depending on your location and needs:

## **Nationwide/International Options**

| Service | Highlights | Delivery |
|---------|-----------|----------|
| **Bake Me a Wish** | Gourmet birthday cakes, personalized messages, kosher & gluten-free options, loyalty program | All 50 US states; overnight shipping |
| **Goldbelly** | Cakes from famous bakeries (Carlo's, Ovenly, etc.), filters for dietary needs (vegan, paleo, gluten-free, kosher) | 48-50 states; shipping times vary |
| **Milk Bar** | Best-selling vanilla rainbow birthday cake, trendy NYC bakery | Nationwide US |
| **Caroline's Cakes** | Nut-free bakery, multilayered cakes, "half cakes" with two flavors | 48 states |
| **We Take the Cake** | Beautifully decorated cakes, free shipping, gluten-free options | 48 states; free shipping |
| **Send A Cake** | Personalized cake explosion boxes with photos, music stands, wind-up butterflies | 48 states |

## **Same-Day/Local Delivery Options**

| Service | Best For | Coverage |
|---------|----------|----------|
| **Instacart** | Budget-friendly supermarket cakes (Costco, Target, Kroger) | Thousands of cities across North America |
| **DoorDash** | Last-minute orders from local restaurants, grocery stores, bakeries | 7,000+ cities in all 50 US states |

## **International/Regional Options**

| Service | Region | Special Features |
|---------|--------|----------------|
| **IGP** | India + 100+ countries (Canada, UAE, Germany) | Same-day delivery, photo cakes, pinata cakes, 400+ Indian cities |
| **Bakingo** | India | Same-day & 2-hour free delivery, 10+ flavors |
| **FNP (Ferns N Petals)** | India, Malaysia, international | Midnight delivery, 2-hour delivery in 350+ Indian cities |
| **Flower Chimp** | Philippines | Ube cakes, Red Ribbon cakes, paired with flowers |
| **Habib Bakery** | Dubai, UAE | Same-day delivery, custom designer cakes, Arabic-inspired flavors |
| **The Hummingbird Bakery** | London, UK | American-inspired cakes, rainbow piñata cakes, personalization |
| **Rakuten** | Japan | Hundreds of birthday cake options (Japanese language site) |

## **Tips for Ordering**

- **For dietary restrictions:** Goldbelly and Bake Me a Wish have the best filtering options for vegan, gluten-free, kosher, and nut-free cakes.
- **For last-minute needs:** Use Instacart or DoorDash for same-day delivery from local stores.
- **For personalization:** Send A Cake and IGP offer photo cakes and custom messages.
- **For international delivery:** IGP and FNP deliver to 100+ countries.

---
